subject: general
question: The cost price of an article is 64% of the marked price. Calculate the gain percent after allowing a discount of 4%.
solution:
Given:

The cost price of the article is 64% of the marked price.

Discount percentage = 4%

Formula used:

x% of a number = Actual number × (x/100)

SP = MP × (100 – Disocunt%)/100

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

Let the mp of the article be Rs. 100, then

Cost price of the article = 100 × (64/100) = Rs. 64

SP of the article = 100 × (96/100) = Rs. 96

Profit = 96 – 64 = Rs. 32

Profit % = (32/64) × 100

⇒ 50%

∴ The required profit% is 50%
